verdict.rationale: Unleash can be driven without the UI. Its Admin API gives full programmatic access to flags, projects, environments, users and integrations (unleash-docs-6, unleash-docs-48), and API keys are explicitly meant for "other tools and automation" (unleash-docs-23). The docs also claim CI/CD pipeline integration (unleash-docs-52), and the server deploys headlessly via Docker Compose (unleash-docs-46). Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI-specific tooling such as pipeline actions or examples, detail on the CI/CD integration beyond a one-line claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
